checks.detail: Engine authority advances while Project Format 2/schema 29 remain frozen.
A script without directives keeps the frozen global behavior.
All contract requirement kinds and budgets normalize deterministically.
Missing declared requirements fail closed with a specific diagnostic.
Deterministic contracts reject host-dependent API usage.
Strict contracts reject fixed-step mutations from rendered-frame callbacks.
Budget limits accept exact global maxima and reject values outside 1..max.
Malformed flags, requirement kinds and budgets remain separately actionable.
Runtime validation, declared limits and session cache invalidation are connected.
Build and Project Health use the same contract analyzer.
Script Studio exposes requirements, budgets and API characteristics; new templates opt in.
Contract UI is explicitly localized in English, German and Chinese.
The current instructions point to the complete inventory and 6.2–7.0 implementation manual.
